audience: project teams that plan and track actions in Hive workspaces

useCases.title: List the actions of a project by deadline
useCases.text: Find the workspace and the project. List the actions for a deadline range, then read the assignees and status of each.

useCases.title: Search actions by title
useCases.text: Search actions by title text in a workspace. Open one action to read its status, deadline and assignees.

useCases.title: Review the subactions and comments of an action
useCases.text: List the subactions of one action. List the comments on the same action.

useCases.title: Find the members and teams of a workspace
useCases.text: List the workspace members and teams. Use the user ids as action assignees.

useCases.title: Create an action in a project
useCases.text: Find the project id, then create an action with a title. The description and assignees are optional.

useCases.title: Comment on an action
useCases.text: Read the comments on an action, then add your own comment to it.
